name: documents
description: DOCX document production skills and a Word viewer panel, published as an official ZCode plugin.

description_i18n.en: Word document production skills for DOCX: create, edit, format, review, and comment. View Word files in a side panel: reference passages in chat, and the agent can read, search, point at and capture them.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 DOCX 的 Word 文档制作技能：创建、编辑、排版、审阅与批注；并可在侧栏查看 Word 文件，把内容引用到对话，Agent 可以阅读、搜索、定位高亮并截取画面。
